overview.headline: Wright brothers path to flight through math physics and aerodynamics

keyPoints.point: Guide uses aeronautics technology lessons to explain the journey of flight.
keyPoints.quote: In the spirit of the Wright Brothers, NASA is using aeronautics technology to provide access to space.

keyPoints.point: Guide shows basic math and physics behind invention of the airplane.
keyPoints.quote: The Wright Way will show you the basic math and physics that led to the invention of the airplane by the Wright Brothers.

keyPoints.point: Elevators are front aircraft wings that control flight attitude.
keyPoints.quote: At the front of all of the Wright brothers’ aircraft one finds the elevators.

keyPoints.point: Simulation seeks flight conditions where aircraft lift exceeds aircraft weight.
keyPoints.quote: The objective of this simulation is to find the flight conditions that produce an aircraft lift greater than the aircraft weight.
